accounting.disc_note: 15us discriminator is launch-dominated / cache-resident, NOT unique-once. Streaming comparison uses 639.25 GB/s.

act_pca_ZV.native: new kernel: s = V^T x (r x K GEMV, V resident if shared); y = Z s (M x r GEMV). MAC immediately. Never materialize M x K.

hadamard.native: new kernel: u = b ⊙ x; FWHT_pad(u); y = a ⊙ u[:M]. Shared memory FWHT. Never materialize W.

circulant.native: new kernel: y = a ⊙ iFFT(λ ⊙ FFT(x_pad)). Metal has no stock FFT; length-8192/32768 FFT is writeable but not free.

prng_per_element.native: thread generates G[i,j] via hash, FMA into acc. Same class as rejected 460us codebook GEMV.
